grade.summary: The submission gives a complete and correct proof of both termination and choice-independence. The lexicographic descent using the total product and the number of entries greater than 1 is valid, and the primewise gcd of valuation exponents is correctly shown to be invariant and to determine the unique terminal entry.
strengths: Correctly distinguishes the cases gcd(m,n)>1 and gcd(m,n)=1 to obtain a well-founded descent.
Correctly proves that at least one entry greater than 1 remains, so a terminal board has exactly one such entry.
Correctly computes the valuation transformation as (x,y) to (min(x,y),|x-y|).
Correctly establishes invariance of the gcd of all p-adic exponents, including cases involving zero exponents.
Correctly reconstructs the terminal integer prime by prime, proving independence from all choices.
